summary: Gemini CLI before 0.1.14 runs injected commands past its allowlist
details: Gemini CLI before 0.1.14 matched shell commands against the user's allowlist inadequately, so a command approved once could carry an appended payload, hidden from the display by whitespace. Instructions planted in a repository's context files trigger it when the tool is run against untrusted code. Running inside one of the tool's sandbox modes contains the impact.

database_specific.why: AVE mirrors component-level records into OSV form so existing OSV scanners can use them without knowing AVE exists. Records OSV cannot express faithfully are marked. See ALTERNATIVES.md.
